claims.text: THE FENCE LIVES IN ONE MODULE, and this file no longer owns a copy of it.
claims.why: No definition or reference to 'FENCE' visible in this chunk; cannot verify.

claims.text: `_identity` and `_overlap_reason` were defined here; `eval/correctness.py` then grew a SECOND answer to the same question that fails OPEN where this one fails closed (see :mod:`daedalus.primary_tree` for the measurement). Importing rather than re-deriving is the whole point -- a caller that needs the comparison must get THIS one.
claims.why: References to symbols and modules not present in this chunk; cannot verify claims about their behavior or origin.

claims.text: The only git verbs this module may aim at the primary checkout. Every one of them reports; none of them writes. Adding a verb here is the single place a reviewer has to look to know whether the no-write property still holds.
claims.why: The verbs are defined, but no usage of them is present in this chunk; cannot verify that they are used only for reporting and not writing.

claims.text: Gate output is retained in full on GateResult. Only the ledger copy is trimmed -- an unbounded pytest log inside a SQLite row would grow the ledger without making any decision better; the digest keeps the trimmed copy honest.
claims.why: GateResult and ledger are not defined in this chunk; cannot verify trimming behavior.
